items.desc: This is a re-recording of the set I played at Subsonic Music Festival in December 2025. Unfortunately my recorder stopped working only 15 minutes into my set, but I received a lot of positive feedback about it, so I figured I would basically "re-do" it. This recording is a close as possible to how I played the set at the festival. I played from 5-6:30pm on the River Stage, which is technically the "opening" set after the Welcome To Country at the festival's main stage.
